name: Amos
overview: Amos is a male prophet known specifically as one from among the sheepherders of Tekoa, as identified in Amos 1:1. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes. His background as a herdsman highlights his humble origins before God called him to prophesy.
namesAndTitles: The name Amos is a proper name meaning 'burden bearer,' as given in Amos 1:1. This meaning reflects the prophetic responsibility of carrying and delivering God's messages to His people.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Amos beyond his identification as a sheepherder from Tekoa. There are no additional relational details provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Amos holds significance as a prophet called from a humble occupation to deliver God's word, emphasizing that God raises leaders from ordinary backgrounds to fulfill His purposes. His role as a prophet from Tekoa underscores the divine calling that transcends social status. Through Amos, God communicated His judgment and calls for repentance to Israel, marking him as an important figure in the biblical narrative.
